concept: Clawd's tiny apartment, one long take that wakes up with him. Each habit is a new action in the same room: the alarm clock jumps off the shelf, the curtain rips open into sunlight, a glass of water pours itself, a phone flies into a drawer. A sunrise behind the window fills up as the progress bar.
shows_off: blocking in one space, squash and stretch, a continuity prop (the sunrise), splat transition into the CTA

lines.text: Your morning decides your whole day. Here are four tiny habits that fix it.
One: put your alarm across the room, so you have to stand up to stop it.
Two: open the curtains first. Daylight tells your brain the night is over.
Three: drink a full glass of water before coffee.
Four: no phone for the first ten minutes. Your day, not everyone else's.
Try all four tomorrow, and tell me which one stuck.
